hardcoded_secret.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 4.2: Access Control & Identity Management; Annex II: Sensitive Data Protection
hardcoded_secret.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 8.2: Protect credentials; Requirement 3.4: Render PAN unreadable
hardcoded_secret.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 4.1: Password Policy; Control 6.1: Operator Session Security
hardcoded_secret.notes: Hardcoded secrets represent an immediate breach risk. All credentials must be stored in secrets management solutions such as HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

sql_injection.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.4: Application Security; Clause 7.1: Secure Coding Standards
sql_injection.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.2: Bespoke and custom software; Requirement 6.3.1: Security vulnerabilities
sql_injection.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 3.2: Malware Protection; Control 7.2: Software Integrity
sql_injection.notes: SQL Injection is in OWASP Top 10 (A03:2021). Banking applications must use parameterized queries or ORM frameworks exclusively.

command_injection.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.4: Application Security; Clause 7.1: Secure Coding Standards
command_injection.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.2.4: Common attacks; Requirement 6.3.1: Vulnerabilities
command_injection.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 7.2: Software Integrity; Control 3.2: Malware Protection
command_injection.notes: Command injection allows attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands. Banking APIs must never pass user input to system calls.

weak_cryptography.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 5.3: Cryptography Policy; Annex IV: Encryption Standards
weak_cryptography.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 4.2.1: Strong cryptography; Requirement 3.5: Use strong cryptography
weak_cryptography.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 2.6: Cryptographic Controls; Control 4.2: Data Encryption
weak_cryptography.notes: MD5, SHA-1, DES, RC4 are cryptographically broken. RBI mandates AES-256 for data at rest and TLS 1.2+ for data in transit.

unsafe_deserialization.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.4: Application Security; Clause 6.5: Input Validation
unsafe_deserialization.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.2.4: Attacks on data integrity; Requirement 6.3.3: All components protected
unsafe_deserialization.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 7.2: Software Integrity; Control 3.1: Malware Protection
unsafe_deserialization.notes: Unsafe deserialization (OWASP A08:2021) can lead to Remote Code Execution. Never deserialize untrusted data with pickle, YAML load, or Java ObjectInputStream.

security_misconfiguration.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 4.4: Security Configuration Management; Clause 8.1: Environment Hardening
security_misconfiguration.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 2.2: System components configured and managed; Requirement 6.2: Secure configurations
security_misconfiguration.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 2.7: System Hardening; Control 1.1: Environment Security
security_misconfiguration.notes: Security misconfigurations are the most prevalent finding class (OWASP A05:2021). Banking systems must follow CIS benchmarks and vendor hardening guides.

vulnerable_dependency.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.6: Patch and Vulnerability Management; Clause 6.7: Third-party Risk
vulnerable_dependency.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.3.3: All system components protected from known vulnerabilities; Requirement 12.8: Third-party service providers
vulnerable_dependency.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 7.1: Vulnerability Scanning; Control 7.3: Patch Management
vulnerable_dependency.notes: Software Composition Analysis (SCA) is mandatory. All third-party libraries must be tracked in an SBOM and patched within SLA timelines defined by RBI.

path_traversal.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.4: Application Security; Clause 6.5: Input Validation
path_traversal.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.2.4: Common vulnerability attacks; Requirement 6.3.1
path_traversal.swift: SWIFT CSP Control 3.2: Malware Protection; Control 7.2: Software Integrity
path_traversal.notes: Path traversal allows attackers to access files outside the intended directory. Banking document systems are especially at risk.

insecure_random.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 5.3: Cryptography Policy; Annex IV: Random Number Generation
insecure_random.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 3.5: Cryptographic key generation; Requirement 4.2.1: Strong cryptography
insecure_random.notes: Non-cryptographic random number generators must not be used for session tokens, OTPs, or cryptographic keys in banking systems.

unknown.rbi: RBI IT Framework 2021 — Section 6.4: Application Security (General)
unknown.pci: PCI DSS v4.0 — Requirement 6.2: Software security (General)
unknown.notes: Review finding manually and map to applicable regulatory controls.
